newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela approves electricity rate increase.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela approves electricity rate increase.

text.p: The Venezuelan government has approved a new increase in electricity tariffs, Energy and Mines Minister Erwin Arrieta said Friday.
"The increase is well below the amount requested by the companies," Arrieta told reporters at Miraflores presidential palace. The minister refused to specify the size of the tariff increase.
The increase, which Arrieta said would be published officially within the next few hours, "varies according to activity, company and region," he said.
Electricity companies, particularly Electricidad de Caracas the leading privately-owned electric utility, have been demanding tariff increases for months to meet spiraling costs.

The National Electricity Commission (CREE) authorized a 9.65 percent tariff increase for Electricidad in August. This followed a 28 percent rate rise in May, but was still labeled as insufficient by company executives.
Arrieta said the system of approving tariff increases would now be reviewed to introduce a new method next year.
